cases.name: the browser tree has real roving focus, stable row geometry, reachable actions and a shared keyboard menu
a failed browser load is a recoverable failure rather than an empty folder
K3: command-palette operation labels use reading words without promising an incremental pass reads every file
K3: the reading-rules palette action uses the same name as the Library editor
K2/K3: one state headline, no count subtitle, Add a folder, healthy rows have one scoped count
K2/M3/M4: expanded facts retain uncertainty, active reading and deletion recovery without expert facts
M5: capped and unknown Library counts keep their scope
M3: no current observation of zero failures says none reported
K4/M2: shared Library menu says what runs; empty and uncertain waiting differ
K5/M1/M7/M11: expert history and activity are opt-in, unavailable removals and other sources stay reachable
K6/M5: Browse column heads, stable root count, byte and shared date presentation, no inline styles
M8: failed Browse children provide Retry and never say empty
M8: truncated, filtered-empty and confirmed-empty are distinct
M9: one tree tab stop, full hierarchy, Right to child, Left to parent, focus after collapse
M10: eight file kind glyphs are distinct and shared with search results
M6/M12: hidden weekday restrictions stay effective across developer visibility changes
K4/M10: opening the Library menu closes the bar menu, and outside clicks inside Library dismiss
M9: file action Enter cannot open the row, and disappearing focused descendants recover to their parent
K4: a hidden Library closes its transient menu before it is shown again
M4: paused meaning work keeps the last read time and never claims Reading now
missingDiskObservationIsUnknownRatherThanAnEmptyFolder()
bothRootResponsesKeepCountAndCap()
anUnreadableSubfolderKeepsTheReadableCountAsALowerBound()
